Context: Instructions for Pension Disbursing Authorities.-

- (x) The additional quantum of pension / family pension will be paid on attaining the age 80 years and above. Additional pension is  
,  
paid from the first day of the month in which a pensioner / family pensioner completes the age of 80 years and above. Bank will not insist for any request / application from pensioners /  
family pensioners in order to pay additional pension to them.  
- OMs, dated 18-7-2019 and 15-5-2020.
